title_en: Opinion of the Supreme People's Court on Further Strengthening the Ideological and Political Construction of People's Courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Further Strengthening the Ideological and Political Construction of People's Courts

Fa Fa [2014] No. 17

To: the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

Ideological and political construction is a fine tradition and political advantage of our Party. The ideological and political construction of the people's courts concerns the forward direction, overall work, and long-term development of the people's courts, and is the lifeline of the work of the people's courts. At present, the people's courts are at a critical period of development and reform, facing heavy and arduous tasks and unprecedented challenges. Strengthening ideological and political construction is an inevitable requirement for adhering to the correct direction of the work of the people's courts, a key link in building a high-quality court team, an important guarantee for successfully completing the tasks of law enforcement and case handling, and a practical need for smoothly advancing the reform of the judicial system. In order to thoroughly implement the spirit of the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the spirit of a series of important speeches by General Secretary Xi Jinping, and to strive to build a court team that is firm in conviction, enforces the law for the people, dares to take responsibility, and is clean and honest, in accordance with relevant requirements of the Central Committee and in light of the current situation and tasks, the following opinions are hereby put forward on further strengthening the ideological and political construction of the people's courts.

I. Further Strengthen Theoretical Armament Work and Strengthen the Ideals and Convictions of Court Personnel

(1) Persist in arming the mind with the theoretical system of socialism with Chinese characteristics. Deeply carry out study and education on Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought, Deng Xiaoping Theory, the important thought of "Three Represents," and the Scientific Outlook on Development, guide court personnel to systematically grasp Marxist positions, viewpoints, and methods, deeply understand the laws of governance by the Communist Party, the laws of socialist construction, and the laws of the development of human society, and further strengthen ideals and beliefs. Deeply study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's series of important speeches, deeply understand the profound connotation of realizing the Chinese Dream of the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation, and further enhance confidence in the path, confidence in the theory, and confidence in the system. Deeply carry out education on the history of the Party and the country, the history of socialist development, and the situation and policies, guide court personnel to distinguish between good and bad, see trends from comparisons of different social systems and different development paths, and deepen political identification, ideological identification, and emotional identification with socialism with Chinese characteristics.

(2) Continuously deepen education on the socialist rule of law concept. Make studying and comprehending General Secretary Xi Jinping's important discussions on the rule of law construction a key content of the socialist rule of law concept education, deeply grasp the study and education of the spirit of the Third Plenary Session of the 18th Central Committee of the Party, deeply understand the goal direction, value orientation, and realization path of the socialist rule of law, enhance confidence in building a socialist country under the rule of law, and uphold and maintain the socialist judicial system with Chinese characteristics. Guide court personnel to deeply understand that adhering to the leadership of the Party is the essential characteristic and political advantage of the socialist judicial system with Chinese characteristics, resolutely resist the influence of erroneous viewpoints such as Western "constitutional democracy" and "judicial independence," resolutely eliminate the erroneous understanding that sets Party leadership in opposition to the rule of law, and always remain true to the political nature of loyalty to the Party, loyalty to the country, loyalty to the people, and loyalty to the law. Use typical cases to carry out "analyzing principles through cases," guide court personnel to fully understand that serving the overall situation and administering justice for the people are inevitable requirements of the socialist judicial system with Chinese characteristics, firmly establish the work goal of "striving to ensure that the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case," and achieve the unity of legal effects and social effects.

(3) Strengthen education on political discipline and organizational discipline. Strictly observe the Party's political discipline, conscientiously implement the Party's line, principles, and policies, consciously safeguard the authority of the Central Committee and the unity and solidarity of the Party, and maintain a high degree of consistency with the Central Committee in thought, politics, and action. Guide court personnel to enhance political sensitivity and political discernment, stand firm on political positions and maintain a clear mind on major issues of principle, resolutely support the decisions of the Central Committee, refrain from making statements inconsistent with the spirit of the Central Committee, and do not listen to or spread political rumors. Guide court personnel to enhance the political sense of responsibility for loving the Party, worrying about the Party, protecting the Party, and revitalizing the Party, dare to take a clear stance and unequivocally refute erroneous viewpoints that deny the Party's leadership or attack the socialist system. Educate court personnel to strengthen the concept of organizational discipline, strictly observe organizational principles, implement the request and reporting system, consciously understand rules and observe discipline, conscientiously implement the decisions and deployments of the Central Committee and the Supreme People's Court, and resolutely oppose acts of disregarding orders and prohibitions. Strengthen the management of court personnel's social accounts such as Weibo and WeChat, and strictly prohibit the dissemination of harmful political information and sensitive work information. Strictly review and control the holding of seminars, symposiums, training courses, forums, and lectures, and do not provide channels and platforms for the spread of erroneous ideological trends.

(4) Strengthen the organization and implementation of theoretical study. Adhere to and improve the study system of the Party Leadership Group Theoretical Study Center Group, formulate annual study plans, clarify study requirements, and ensure study time. Take collective study and discussion as the main form of study by the center group, closely follow the spirit of the Central Committee and major issues in the work of the courts to determine key topics, research and propose ideas and countermeasures for solving problems, and ensure that the total time for collective study and discussion each year is not less than 12 days. Deeply grasp the on-the-job self-study and independent study of leading cadres at all levels in the courts, and adopt forms such as thematic counseling, discussion and exchange, self-study, and knowledge competitions to carry out regular theoretical study for court personnel. Give full play to the main channel role of judge training institutions at all levels, and make ideological and political training a compulsory content of various types of training courses. For training courses targeting leading cadres, young court personnel, preparatory judges, and newly recruited personnel, the proportion of ideological and political training content shall not be less than 30%. In conjunction with studying important central spirit and carrying out major thematic activities, timely carry out special rotation training on ideological and political construction. Promote the study style of integrating theory with practice, adhere to learning for application and using learning to promote learning, form high-quality learning results, and promote the development of court work.

II. Cultivate and Practice Socialist Core Values, Guide the Value Pursuit of Court Personnel

(5) Conscientiously carry out study and education on socialist core values. Deeply study and comprehend General Secretary Xi Jinping's important discussions on socialist core values and the Central Committee's "Opinions on Cultivating and Practicing Socialist Core Values," guide court personnel to deeply understand the scientific connotation and essential requirements of the core values, and fully recognize the great significance of cultivating and practicing the core values for realizing the Chinese Dream of the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. In conjunction with the trial functions of the courts, strengthen research and publicity on the core values, and deeply interpret the practical requirements of the core values for court work and court personnel. Incorporate the study and education of core values into the study plan of the Party Leadership Group Theoretical Study Center Group, into the content of judge training, and into regular ideological education, and extensively carry out activities such as thematic essay writing, full-staff reading, speech contests, and special reports, prompting court personnel to internalize socialist core values as their own value concepts and spiritual pursuits.

(6) Strengthen education on judicial conscience and the professional ethics of judges. In accordance with the requirements of socialist core values, cultivate the judicial conscience of court personnel, promote the construction of professional ethics of judges, guide court personnel to firmly uphold the value pursuit of fairness and justice, take strict law enforcement and impartiality and integrity as the highest standards, and take bending the law for personal gain and injustice and corruption as the greatest shame. Make education on judicial conscience and professional ethics of judges an important content of judge training, especially as a compulsory course for preparatory judges and newly recruited court personnel for special training. Strengthen the practice of developing professional ethics of judges, guide court personnel to start from handling each specific case, adhere to taking facts as the basis and law as the criterion, be impartial and not biased, and not wrong or lenient. Establish advanced models who exemplarily practice the professional ethics of judges, and take forms such as admonishing talks, moral evaluations, and disciplinary sanctions to punish acts that violate the professional ethics of judges. Use typical cases where erroneous judgments led to serious consequences to conduct warning education, and strengthen the professional ethics awareness of court personnel.

(7) Guide court personnel to consciously practice socialist core values. Implement socialist core values into the practice of law enforcement and case handling, give full play to the normative, guiding, and guaranteeing role of law, and use all the work of the people's courts to promote national prosperity, democracy, civilization, and harmony, promote social freedom, equality, justice, and the rule of law, and promote citizens' patriotism, dedication, integrity, and friendliness. Guide court personnel to practice socialist core values based on their trial positions, believe in and abide by the rule of law, abide by the professional ethics of judges, strictly, fairly, and civilly administer justice, maintain social fairness and justice, and promote the construction of core values through practical actions. Strengthen education on the moral conduct of court personnel, guide court personnel to consciously abide by social ethics and family virtues, resolutely resist the influence of hedonism and extravagance, pursue noble moral sentiments, consciously stay away from vulgar tastes, establish a good social image of court personnel, and play an exemplary role in practicing core values.

(8) Create a strong atmosphere for promoting socialist core values. Fully utilize various media within the court system to strengthen the publicity and education of socialist core values, and use positive and uplifting mainstream ideological public opinion to guide the value concepts of court personnel. Strengthen and improve the publicity and commendation of advanced models, enrich the types and levels of models, innovate the methods and carriers of model publicity, and use different types of advanced models to concretize, visualize, and personalize the core values. Use socialist core values to guide the construction of court culture, actively create court cultural works that embody core value concepts and guide the value pursuit of court personnel, and extensively carry out court cultural activities that promote the main theme and spread positive energy. Adhere to hoisting the national flag and playing and singing the national anthem in important places and during important activities, and extensively carry out ritual education such as judge oath-taking.

III. Strengthen Regular Ideological Education, Guide Court Personnel to Love the Judicial Cause

(9) Lay a solid ideological foundation for court personnel to love the judicial cause. Organize court personnel to deeply study and comprehend the decisions and deployments of the Central Committee on comprehensively advancing the rule of law, fully recognize the bright prospects of building a rule of law China and the mission and responsibility of the people's courts, and guide court personnel to integrate their personal ideals and career pursuits into the great cause of building a rule of law China. In conjunction with the practice of law enforcement and case handling, guide court personnel to fully recognize the sacred mission of the people's courts in maintaining overall social stability, promoting social fairness and justice, and ensuring the people live and work in peace and contentment, fully recognize that judicial adjudication is the last line of defense for maintaining fairness and justice, further enhance value identification and emotional identification with trial work, and strengthen the ideal pursuit of dedicating oneself to the judicial cause. Extensively carry out learning activities from advanced models such as "the most beautiful grassroots judges," guide court personnel to correctly understand and treat hardship and pleasure, gain and loss, fame and profit, honor and disgrace, and unwaveringly stick to their trial posts without regret.

(10) Timely solve the practical ideological problems of court personnel. Establish a communication mechanism between leading cadres and frontline court personnel, regularly listen to the opinions and suggestions of court personnel, and understand the practical issues that court personnel care about and are concerned with. Aiming at the tendency of ideological problems among court personnel, increase the intensity of positive education, do a good job of encouraging and boosting morale, and uniting efforts, guide court personnel to establish lofty ideals, strengthen the spirit of dedication, correct value pursuit, love the trial cause, and correct phenomena such as comparing incomes, calculating gains and losses, complaining and grumbling, and calling hardship and fatigue. Establish and implement the system of heart-to-heart talks and visits, do a good job of ideological guidance for each person and each matter. Leading cadres should have heart-to-heart talks at least once a year with the heads of departments under their charge or court personnel in their own departments. When court personnel encounter job adjustments, work setbacks, family difficulties, hospitalization, unexpected changes, etc., timely carry out heart-to-heart guidance and visits and condolences. Carry out mental health education and psychological adjustment ability training, purposefully do a good job of psychological counseling, help court personnel resolve bad emotions and relieve psychological pressure.

(11) Stimulate the enthusiasm of court personnel for loving their jobs and being dedicated. Care for and love grassroots court personnel politically, in work, and in life, respect and guarantee the principal status of court personnel, enhance the sense of ownership of court personnel, and adhere to retaining people with career, retaining people with emotion, and retaining people with appropriate treatment. Adhere to the selection and appointment of cadres in a fair and upright manner, form a correct orientation for personnel use, so that cadres with a strong sense of career and outstanding performance have development prospects. Give full play to the incentive function of commendation and rewards, conscientiously do a good job of selecting and commending trial business experts, model judges, outstanding judges, case handling pacesetters, etc., and encourage court personnel to create a brilliant life based on their own positions. Care for and love advanced models, create favorable conditions for their growth and progress, and give priority to promotion and appointment under the same conditions. Conscientiously do a good job of awarding the "Honorary Balance Medal," and stimulate the sense of professional honor of court personnel. Give full play to the advantages of the organization to help court personnel solve practical difficulties such as housing, family employment, and children's enrollment in kindergarten and school. Conscientiously implement the systems of physical examinations, vacations, and recuperation, and do a good job of condolence and assistance for court personnel in difficulty. Clearly support court personnel in resisting interference and administering justice impartially, and support cadres who dare to adhere to principles. Establish and improve systems and measures to protect the personal dignity and personal safety of court personnel, and in accordance with the law, stop and punish acts of insulting, slandering, intimidating, and harming court personnel.

IV. Do a Good Job of Ideological and Political Work in Judicial Reform, Ensure the Smooth Implementation of Reform

(12) Educate and guide court personnel to understand and support judicial reform. Deeply study and comprehend General Secretary Xi Jinping's important discussions on comprehensively deepening reform and the "Decision of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Several Major Issues Concerning Comprehensively Deepening Reform," conscientiously study and implement the decisions and deployments of the Central Committee on judicial system reform, guide court personnel to understand and recognize judicial system reform from the strategic height of comprehensively advancing the rule of law, fully recognize the great significance of judicial system reform in breaking down institutional and mechanistic obstacles that restrict impartial justice and building a fair, efficient, and authoritative socialist judicial system, correctly understand the goals and direction of judicial system reform, and effectively unify thought and understanding with the decisions and deployments of the Central Committee, correctly understand reform, strengthen confidence in reform, and resolutely support and endorse reform.

(13) Educate and guide court personnel to actively participate in judicial reform. Integrate ideological and political work throughout the entire process of judicial system reform, clarify vague understanding, eliminate doubts and concerns, maximize the gathering of positive energy, ensure that morale does not scatter, order does not become chaotic, work does not stop, and ensure the smooth implementation of reform measures. Strengthen the analysis of the ideological situation of court personnel, accurately grasp the ideological reflections of court personnel, purposefully do a good job of education and guidance, and solve the practical ideological problems of court personnel. Strengthen policy publicity and public opinion guidance on judicial reform to avoid misinterpretation or blind speculation about reform policies by court personnel. Adhere to and implement the mass line, fully listen to the opinions and suggestions of court personnel, implement reform openly, fairly, and impartially, and avoid affecting the enthusiasm of court personnel to participate in and support reform due to covert operations.

(14) Educate and guide court personnel to correctly treat gains and losses. Aiming at the adjustment of interest patterns triggered by deepening reform, educate and guide court personnel to strengthen the overall situation awareness, submit to the needs of reform, and prevent narrow thinking that only pays attention to personal gains and losses while ignoring the realization of reform goals. Guide court personnel to correctly understand China's national conditions, and prevent unrealistic expectations for increasing income and treatment. Guide court personnel to correctly treat the income and treatment gaps brought about by the classified management of judicial personnel, maintain a calm and peaceful mindset, and prevent blind comparison and haggling over every penny. Guide court personnel to correctly reflect their interests and demands, fully trust and rely on the organization, consciously obey the organization's arrangements, and prevent the dissemination of inappropriate remarks or the adoption of individual extreme behaviors.

V. Give Play to the Guiding Role of Ideological Education, Promote the Construction of Judicial Conduct

(15) Consolidate and expand the achievements of the Party's mass line education practice activities. Deeply study and comprehend General Secretary Xi Jinping's important discussions on education practice activities and conduct construction, firmly establish the concept that conduct construction is always on the way, prevent the mindset of passing the test and relaxing emotions, and unremittingly promote the construction of judicial conduct. Deepen education on the Party's mass line and the nature and purpose of the people's courts, guide court personnel to solve the fundamental issue of "where power comes from and for whom justice is administered," overcome the bureaucratic thinking and yamen style of looking down on others, and further strengthen the purpose consciousness of administering justice for the people. Strengthen the construction of grass-roots service-oriented Party organizations, organize court personnel to extensively carry out activities such as legal publicity, legal consultation, volunteer service, pairing assistance, etc., promote judicial convenience working mechanisms such as "the masses talk about matters, judges talk about the law," and go deep into the grass-roots to contact and serve the masses. Continuously and deeply rectify the "six difficulties and three cases" issue, strictly assess and inspect, strengthen supervision and accountability, and resolutely correct phenomena such as laziness, slackness, procrastination, and "officials not acting." Institutionalize effective practices in education practice activities, improve and perfect the long-term mechanism for conduct construction, and prevent the rebound of judicial conduct problems.

(16) Further strengthen the concept of law and discipline among court personnel. Organize court personnel to carefully study inner-party regulations such as the Inner-Party Supervision Regulations, the Disciplinary Action Regulations, and the Several Guidelines on Integrity and Self-Discipline for Leading Cadres of Party Members, carefully study the various disciplinary regulations promulgated by the Central Committee since the 18th National Congress, guide court personnel to strengthen Party spirit cultivation, enhance awareness of law and discipline, and resolutely hold the "gate of Party spirit, gate of discipline, gate of law, gate of power, and gate of integrity." Deeply carry out education on trial work discipline, organize court personnel to carefully study system regulations such as the Judges Law, the Disciplinary Action Regulations for Court Staff, the Professional Ethics Standards for Judges, the Code of Conduct for Judges, and the Norms for Civilized Language, adhere to strict, fair, and civilized justice, and resolutely overcome behaviors such as coldness, hardness, pushing, and extortion in law enforcement and case handling. Deeply carry out disciplinary education on clean and honest justice, organize court personnel to carefully study system regulations such as the "five prohibitions," preventing internal personnel from interfering in case handling, preventing conflicts of interest, and consciously accepting supervision by litigants, strengthen bottom-line thinking and self-discipline awareness, prevent and overcome fluke mentality, and resolutely hold the bottom line of clean and honest justice.

(17) Timely correct emerging problems in judicial conduct. Firmly establish the concept that "strict management is deep care," adhere to principles, dare to grasp and manage, and effectively correct the tendency of lax and soft team management. Understand and grasp the situation of court personnel's law enforcement and case handling and off-duty activities, pay attention to court personnel's life circle, social circle, and entertainment circle, and frequently analyze the status of team discipline and conduct. Give full play to the role of integrity supervisors and reporting websites of people's courts at all levels, and increase supervision over trial and execution work. Establish and improve the supervisory and management talk system for cadres, and when emerging or tendency problems are discovered, timely carry out criticism and education, achieving early detection, early warning, and early correction. Strictly implement the system regulations on conduct construction, seriously investigate and punish violations of discipline by court personnel, timely notify typical cases, regularly carry out warning education, and promote the formation of a clean and upright environment and atmosphere.

VI. Further Strengthen the Organizational Leadership of Ideological and Political Construction

(18) Strengthen the leading role and main responsibility of the Party Leadership Groups of people's courts at all levels. Place ideological and political construction in the primary position of the self-construction of the court Party Leadership Group team, strictly implement the study system of the Party Leadership Group Theoretical Study Center Group, conscientiously implement democratic centralism, enhance the political nature and principle of inner-Party life, and set an example for court personnel in terms of firm ideals and beliefs, abiding by Party discipline, exercising power with integrity and fairness, daring to take responsibility, and being willing to contribute. The court Party Leadership Group should earnestly assume the main responsibility for leading the ideological and political construction of the court team, the Party Leadership Group Secretary should fulfill the responsibility of the first responsible person, and each member of the Party Leadership Group has the responsibility to grasp ideological and political construction. Include ideological and political construction in the important agenda of the Party Leadership Group, adhere to studying, deploying, inspecting, and evaluating it together with trial business work. Establish a system for analyzing the ideological situation of court personnel, regularly listen to reports on the situation of ideological and political construction, and timely study and solve related issues.

(19) Establish a pattern of ideological and political work in which all departments work together. The political departments and party committees of people's courts at all levels shall, in accordance with their respective responsibilities, conscientiously perform the work of planning, research, deployment, promotion, organization, coordination, supervision, and guidance of ideological and political construction. Every court department has the responsibility to strengthen its own ideological and political construction, and the head of the department shall effectively fulfill the "dual responsibility for both work and party building." Integrate ideological and political work organically with cadre management, trial management, disciplinary inspection and supervision, logistical support, information technology construction, and other tasks, so that all work can play a role in guiding the thinking of judicial personnel. Improve the organizational structure of grassroots party branches in courts, ensure that grassroots party branch secretaries are fully staffed and competent, and conduct regular centralized training. Strengthen the contingent of political work cadres, party affairs cadres, and integrity supervision officers, maintaining both stability and reasonable mobility. Adhere to the principle of using party building to drive union building, youth league building, and women's organization building, and give full play to the role of mass organizations in connecting with and uniting judicial personnel. The Supreme People's Court shall commend outstanding Communist Party members, outstanding party affairs workers, and advanced grassroots party organizations in the national court system every five years, giving full play to the exemplary role of advanced models in ideological and political construction.

(20) Improve and refine the mechanism for ideological and political work. Establish a reporting system for ideological and political construction work reports, whereby grassroots party branch secretaries report specially each year to the party committee of the organ, and the secretary of the party committee of the organ reports on work to the party leadership group of the court. Improve the assessment and incentive mechanism for ideological and political construction, incorporating the status of ideological and political construction into the comprehensive performance evaluation index system, and using the evaluation results as an important basis for selecting advanced models and awarding commendations. Improve the guidance mechanism for the ideological and political construction of the court system, strengthen follow-up guidance and supervision and inspection, and carry out special activities as appropriate. Improve the discussion and exchange mechanism for ideological and political construction, conduct theoretical research, strengthen information exchange, summarize and promote experience, and promote the overall development of ideological and political construction in the court system.

(21) Innovate methods and carriers for ideological and political work. Give full play to the principal role of judicial personnel, extensively carry out participatory, interactive, and experiential education, hold activities such as judge forums, knowledge competitions, speech contests, and artistic performances, organize judicial personnel to interact and exchange with advanced models, moral exemplars, and grassroots people, visit patriotic education bases, revolutionary tradition education bases, and integrity education bases for study tours, and go to remote and arduous areas for social practice. Give full play to the ideological education function of information networks and new media, set up ideological education theme websites and special webpages, enrich online education resources, and adopt forms such as "online party branches" and "online classrooms" to carry out ideological education. Establish court Weibo groups and WeChat groups to provide real-time ideological guidance to judicial personnel, enhancing the appeal, contemporary relevance, and effectiveness of ideological education.

September 3, 2014
